svg.title: AQG Studio. Documents in, grounded quizzes out. A full-stack assessment platform with a LangGraph pipeline, retrieval, quality checks, human review, and exports to learning platforms.
svg.desc: A full-stack assessment platform that turns PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and text documents into grounded quizzes. A Next.js and TypeScript frontend pairs with a FastAPI backend and LangGraph multi-agent pipeline for document parsing, pgvector-backed RAG, quality checks, human review, and exports to Moodle XML, QTI, PDF, DOCX, JSON, and CSV. Model access routes through OpenRouter with NVIDIA NIM fallback. Technologies: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Next.js, pgvector. Open repository.
